flatPolicy: close >= open is green, including ties
sessionPolicy: continuous across sessions; ordinary candles do not reset
outcome: next completed doji is green; unknown until that doji closes
baseline: next doji green after any green marker whose signal closes in the evaluation window
secondary: real close higher three contiguous same-session candles later
limits: Review requires both date and count, not proof of reliability. No trade win rate, target, stop, costs, or profitability is tested. No tuning this definition against interim outcomes.
